notes.title: Seaberry Keep is released!
notes.content:
Seaberry Keep is released on Steam with a 40% launch discount!  If you get a chance, writing a review with feedback helps me out a lot.  I appreciate your support!

notes.title: Seaberry Keep Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[h3]The demo is now live![/h3]

The Seaberry Keep demo on Steam is approximately 10-15 minutes in length, and includes most of the key features of the main game: 
[list][*] Introduction to the story and characters
[*] Gardening feature
[*] Room decoration [/list]

[h3]Share your thoughts![/h3]

Feel free to share your feedback on the demo in the Steam forums! 

If you like the demo, you can wishlist the game to be notified when it releases in November :)
